title: 第32章 越穷越光荣！

第32章 越穷越光荣！-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》

刘济民在燕影厂过得很爽，唯一美中不足的是，没能有机会批判批判女演员送来的不正之风。
来找刘济民最多的是梁晓生，每次必要问一句刘济民改稿进度如何。
当然，刘济民每次的回答也都是....有了。
但半个多月过去了，还是....有了。
刘济民语重心长地告诉梁晓生，作家的事情急不得。
进入八月，《解放军文艺》杂志刊登了《归队》的上半部，杂志发行后，反响极为热烈，这一期的《解放军文艺》还小小的加印了五万册。
自从刘济民在《解放军文艺》杂志发表小说后，在新华书店工作的李春燕对这本杂志就格外关注。
八月期刚到新华书店，李春燕就看到了刘济民写的《归队》。
“王姐，我跟你换换，我来卖杂志吧。”李春燕凑到王姐旁边，抱着她的胳膊摇了摇，像是在撒娇。
“行，你来你来！”王姐巴不得换呢，每月一号是许多杂志发行的日子，第一天上市，过来购买的读者极多，是个忙活。
一上午时间，李春燕算了算，《解放军文艺》卖出去了八百多册：“我们大杂院，这次是真出作家了！”
“春燕，你高兴个啥劲儿？”王姐打趣道。
“谁让我们是哥们儿，我跟王姨的关系也特好，就是吧...”李春燕没说下去。
王姨追问道：“就是什么？”
“就是给我介绍的对象不怎么样！”
“哈哈哈，改天我给你介绍个。”
李春燕中午回到大杂院，看到正在做饭的王爱梅，扯着嗓子喊道：“王姨，你家老二又发表小说了，今天卖的还特好。”
“真的？”王爱梅忙在围裙上擦了擦沾水的手，快速接过了李春燕递过来的杂志。
“在这儿，对，就是《归队》，但是只写了半部，估计下半部要到九月刊了。”
王爱梅笑容非常夸张：“这臭小子，在燕影厂改剧本也不消停，又是剧本又是小说，身体哪能吃得消啊！”
“王姨，恭喜您了，你呀要享福喽！”李春燕吹捧的时候，又用目光斜视了一眼跟王爱梅不对付的一家人。

Liu Jimin had a great time at Yanying Studio. The only flaw was that he did not have the opportunity to criticize the unhealthy trends sent by the actresses.
The person who came to see Liu Jimin the most was Liang Xiaosheng. Every time he had to ask Liu Jimin how the revision of the manuscript was progressing.
Of course, Liu Jimin's answer every time is... Yes.
But more than half a month has passed, and it still...is there.
Liu Jimin told Liang Xiaosheng earnestly that there was no need to rush the writer's affairs.
In August, the "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art" magazine published the first half of "Returning to the Army". After the magazine was released, the response was extremely enthusiastic. This issue of "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art" even printed a small print of 50,000 copies.
Ever since Liu Jimin published his novel in the magazine "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art", Li Chunyan, who works at Xinhua Bookstore, has paid special attention to this magazine.
As soon as the August issue arrived at Xinhua Bookstore, Li Chunyan saw "Returning to the Team" written by Liu Jimin.
"Sister Wang, let me trade with you. I will sell magazines." Li Chunyan came to Sister Wang, held her arm and shook her, as if she was coquettishly coquettish.
"Okay, you come and you come!" Sister Wang is eager to change. The first of every month is the day when many magazines are released. On the first day they go on sale, there are many readers who come to buy them, which is a busy job.
In one morning, Li Chunyan calculated that more than 800 copies of "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art" had been sold: "Our courtyard has a real writer this time!"
"Chunyan, why are you so happy?" Sister Wang joked.
"We are buddies, and I have a very good relationship with Aunt Wang, that's right..." Li Chunyan stopped talking.
Aunt Wang asked: "What is it?"
"It's just that the person you introduced me to is not very good!"
"Hahaha, I'll introduce it to you another day."
Li Chunyan returned to the courtyard at noon and saw Wang Aimei cooking. She shouted at the top of her lungs: "Aunt Wang, your second brother has published a novel again, and the sales are very good today."
"Really?" Wang Aimei wiped her wet hands on her apron and quickly took the magazine handed over by Li Chunyan.
"Here, yes, it's "Return to the Team", but I've only written half of it. I guess the second half will be published in September."
Wang Aimei's smile was very exaggerated: "This brat is constantly rewriting scripts at Yan Film Studio. He is both a script and a novel. How can his body bear it?"
"Aunt Wang, congratulations, you're going to be blessed!" While Li Chunyan was complimenting her, she glanced sideways at the family who were not dealing with Wang Aimei.
